description: This file defines the StringPromotionTypeCoercion object, a helper for type coercion in Spark SQL, specifically handling string promotion in binary arithmetic, comparison, and equality expressions.

classes.name: StringPromotionTypeCoercion
classes.description: A helper object for type coercion involving string promotion in Spark SQL expressions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs type coercion on the given expression, handling string promotion in binary arithmetic, equality, and comparison expressions.

methods.name: castExpr
methods.description: Casts an expression to a target data type, handling null types appropriately.

methods.name: isIntervalType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is an interval type (CalendarIntervalType or AnsiIntervalType).
